changes.why: v0.23.0 passes the callback (element, accumulator): fn(list[idx], acc), was fn(acc, list[idx]); the signature changed
v0.23.0 calls fn(element, acc) and returns [list, acc], was fn(acc, element) and [acc, list]; the signature changed

v0.23.0 splices a copy: a negative start counts from the end and a negative count is 0 (remove(-1, 2, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) is [1, 2, 3, 4], was [2, 3, 4, 5]); the precondition 0 <= start + count is dropped
v0.23.0 drops _slice for the native slice, whose negative end counts from the end: aperture(-1, [1, 2]) is [[1], [], [], []], was four empty windows
v0.23.0 applies the last function to a plain value and chains the others: composeK(f, g)(x) is chain(f, g(x)), was chain(f, chain(g, m)) on a monadic value; the signature changed
knock-on: pipeK(f, g) is composeK(g, f), so it takes a value since v0.23.0; the signature changed
v0.23.0's sequence passes reduceRight a callback taking (x, acc), as reduceRight's order changed: the revealed body is rewritten with the same results
knock-on: the revealed body calls sequence, whose revealed body was rewritten with the same results
